text:
anya: Quick skim of L4/T4/A10G perf across regions for embeddings + small-chat. dropping raw numbers and a couple of kernel notes. pinging @mike @sara for ops/quality checks.

benchbot: ran 30m micro-sweeps (p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens). command:
```
./bench --model small-chat --workload embeddings,chat --gpus L4,T4,A10G --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2,ap-southeast-1 --qconfigs q8_0,q4_0 --duration 30m
```

benchbot: summary (p50 / p95 ms | tok/s | $/1M tok):
- L4 eu-west-1: chat 45 / 120 | 850 tok/s | $16.8 ; emb 18 / 55 | 2.1k tok/s | $7.3
- T4 us-west-2: chat 70 / 210 | 520 tok/s | $9.5 ; emb 26 / 80 | 1.3k tok/s | $4.1
- A10G ap-southeast-1: chat 38 / 98 | 980 tok/s | $22.0 ; emb 16 / 48 | 2.4k tok/s | $9.2

mike: interesting — A10G wins latency/throughput but cost per token worse (esp in apac). Did we use fused attention kernels on A10G for chat?

benchbot: yes, A10G run used `kernel=fused_attn_v2` for small-chat; L4/T4 used `kernel=standard` and `kernel=optimized_sm` respectively where available.

sara: any quality diffs with q4_0 vs q8_0 on chat? we saw regressions earlier on certain prompts.

anya: brief QA: we ran evalset-1k (dialogic) — EM-like metric ~0.92 for q8_0, ~0.90 for q4_0 on small-chat (mostly syntactic drops). embeddings cosine retention >0.997 across q4/q8.

oliver: capacity note — for Dedicated sizing, double the L4 pool for chat if targeting p95 < 150ms in eu. T4 needs 1.8x for same throughput. A10G can hit target with smaller pool but watch region cost buckets.

mike: ops ask — can we pin fallback policy so eu->us overflow uses T4 rather than A10G (cheaper) during bursts?

anya: yes, routing policy prototype attached in thread (snippet):
```
route_policy:
  primary: eu-west-1:L4
  overflow:
    - eu-west-1:T4
    - us-west-2:T4
    - ap-southeast-1:A10G
  fallback: degrade-to-emb-only
```

sara: thanks — will run targeted eval on 200 sensitive prompts (privacy/legal) to double-check q4 regressions.

anya: noted. will re-run with longer windows and upload full csv to S3. tl;dr: A10G best perf, T4 best $/latency balance in us, L4 strong in eu latency but higher cost than T4 for embeddings. :chart_with_upwards_trend: :eyes:

mike: ack

oliver: +1
